name: mcode-trajectory-studio
description: 只读查看本机 MiniMax Code 会话轨迹：轮次、步骤、LLM 与工具的墙钟耗时、token 用量、工具入参与结果、上下文拆分、压缩与子代理任务，并附带一个本地交互式面板。数据取自本地运行时自身的 SQLite 投影；插件不写入会话存储、不联网、不收集遥测。需要宿主运行时提供 Node.js 22 及以上（使用内置 node:sqlite）。 / Read-only inspection of local MiniMax Code session trajectories: turns, steps, LLM and tool wall-clock time, token usage, tool arguments and results, context breakdown, compactions and sub-agent tasks, plus a local interactive panel. Data comes from the local runtime's own SQLite projection; the Plugin never writes to session storage, never touches the network and collects no telemetry. Requires Node.js 22 or newer from the host runtime (uses the built-in node:sqlite).
